tithi.name: Krishna Ekadashi
tithi.description: Rama Ekadashi, highly auspicious for devotion to Lord Vishnu and seeking liberation from past transgressions.

Mesha.summary: Creative energy surges today, opening rewarding avenues in creative and speculative domains.
Mesha.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 5th house in Simha
Mesha.general: Your intellect and creative intuition are heightened, allowing you to solve complex challenges with poise. Joy through family and spiritual activities brings deep contentment.
Mesha.career: Innovative solutions and fresh initiatives will earn you commendation from superiors. If you work in teaching, design, or research, expect significant breakthroughs today.
Mesha.finance: Financial prospects remain optimistic with opportunities for calculated gains in markets. Avoid impulsive splurging on entertainment and maintain a focused budget.
Mesha.relationships: Romantic conversations flourish as you express your feelings with warmth and clarity. Spending quality time with children or younger siblings brings genuine delight.
Mesha.health: Vitality is robust, though light physical exercise will help keep energy balanced. Watch your digestion by favoring cooling, home-cooked foods.
Mesha.remedy: Offer yellow flowers to Lord Vishnu and recite 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya' 11 times.

Vrishabha.summary: Focus shifts to home and inner tranquility as domestic matters demand loving attention.
Vrishabha.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 4th house in Simha
Vrishabha.general: A day to balance your professional ambitions with personal emotional well-being. Cultivating quietude and organizing your living space will restore inner harmony.
Vrishabha.career: You may feel divided between household priorities and impending workplace targets. Prioritize carefully and avoid getting drawn into unnecessary workplace politics.
Vrishabha.finance: Expenditures related to home maintenance or vehicles could arise today. Thoughtful planning ensures these expenses remain well within your planned limits.
Vrishabha.relationships: Tender emotional support from maternal figures or elders will guide your decisions. Avoid rigid stances with family members to maintain domestic peace.
Vrishabha.health: Take extra care of your chest and digestion by avoiding cold or greasy meals. Practicing pranayama in the morning will keep mental restlessness at bay.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer raw milk and water to a Shiva Lingam for mental clarity and domestic tranquility.

Mithuna.summary: Your courage and persuasive communication yield commendable victories across your endeavors.
Mithuna.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 3rd house in Simha
Mithuna.general: Energetic and proactive vibes inspire you to take bold initiatives today. Short journeys and dynamic communications lead to fruitful outcomes and new contacts.
Mithuna.career: Marketing, media, sales, and writing pursuits will witness exceptional progress. Colleagues will look up to your ability to communicate complex concepts smoothly.
Mithuna.finance: Gains through self-effort, commissions, or freelancing are strongly indicated today. A prudent investment in skill development will provide fruitful long-term dividends.
Mithuna.relationships: Bonding with siblings and close peers proves joyful and mutually inspiring. A thoughtful message or spontaneous outing will brighten your partner's mood.
Mithuna.health: Stamina is strong, encouraging you to engage in fitness and active routines. Keep your shoulders and neck relaxed, particularly if working long hours at a desk.
Mithuna.remedy: Offer green grass (Durva) to Lord Ganesha and chant 'Om Gan Ganapataye Namah'.

Karka.summary: Monetary prudence and gracious speech will build trust and reinforce family security.
Karka.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 2nd house in Simha
Karka.general: Your words carry persuasive weight today, making it ideal for important negotiations. Savor family traditions and reflect on preserving your accumulated resources.
Karka.career: Your practical advice will be widely respected in team meetings and business discussions. Focus on consolidating ongoing assignments rather than initiating entirely new ones.
Karka.finance: Promising trends for savings and recovering pending dues emerge today. A deliberate review of your household finances brings reassurance and clarity.
Karka.relationships: Family bonds deepen as you handle delicate conversations with maturity and warmth. Sharing a nourishing meal together will bring shared happiness.
Karka.health: Pay mindful attention to your throat and oral health; stay well hydrated. Moderation in dietary intake will keep you energetic and feeling light.
Karka.remedy: Drink water from a silver vessel and seek blessings from your mother or an elder woman.

Simha.summary: Personal magnetism radiates as the Moon graces your sign, infusing vigor into your day.
Simha.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 1st house in Simha
Simha.general: Self-assurance and radiant enthusiasm accompany you throughout the day. People naturally gravitate toward your leadership, making it a great time for self-expression.
Simha.career: You take central stage effortlessly, steering challenging projects toward completion. Your vision will impress authorities and open pathways for future elevation.
Simha.finance: Personal investments and ventures undertaken with confidence yield promising signs. Avoid ostentatious spending merely to impress peers or acquaintances.
Simha.relationships: Generosity and warmth illuminate your partnership, dissolving previous misunderstandings. Singles may encounter someone captivating through a social gathering.
Simha.health: Overall vitality is excellent, giving you a vibrant glow and high energy. Maintain balanced hydration and avoid excessive exposure to direct heat or stress.
Simha.remedy: Offer Arghya (water with a pinch of Roli) to Surya Deva at sunrise while chanting the Gayatri Mantra.

Kanya.summary: Introspection and careful deliberation are advised; channel energy into spiritual wellness.
Kanya.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 12th house in Simha
Kanya.general: A quieter pace allows you to evaluate recent decisions and recharge your inner strength. Steer clear of haste, and embrace solitude for productive reflection.
Kanya.career: Behind-the-scenes work and long-term planning will prove far more rewarding than public presentations. Foreign collaborations or remote projects progress smoothly.
Kanya.finance: Keep a close watch on unplanned expenses, especially regarding travel or online purchases. Defer speculative financial commitments until a more auspicious transit.
Kanya.relationships: Practice empathy and give your partner space if emotional conversations become intense. Clear communication prevents minor assumptions from turning into friction.
Kanya.health: Ensure adequate rest to prevent fatigue and eye strain after extended screen time. A soothing herbal tea before bedtime will encourage sound sleep.
Kanya.remedy: Feed green fodder or spinach to a cow and donate seasonal fruits to someone in need.

Tula.summary: A highly rewarding day for social connectivity, professional gains, and fulfilling goals.
Tula.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 11th house in Simha
Tula.general: Auspicious alignments facilitate the realization of long-held aspirations and helpful connections. Collaborative ventures and networking yield exceptionally productive results.
Tula.career: Your ability to build consensus makes you an invaluable contributor in group endeavors. Opportunities for professional recognition and lucrative project assignments expand.
Tula.finance: Monetary gains through multiple avenues and previous investments look very bright. It is an auspicious day to set long-term financial milestones.
Tula.relationships: Friendships bring uplifting joy, and an influential friend may offer timely encouragement. Romantic bonds blossom in an atmosphere of mutual celebration and trust.
Tula.health: Physical and emotional wellness are in harmony, keeping your energy vibrant. Maintain healthy eating habits to sustain your natural vitality.
Tula.remedy: Light a ghee lamp in front of Goddess Lakshmi and chant 'Om Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah'.

Vrischika.summary: Professional authority rises as your diligence and dedication take center stage.
Vrischika.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 10th house in Simha
Vrischika.general: Your sense of duty and determination will guide you toward significant vocational achievements. You will command respect from both peers and superiors through thoughtful action.
Vrischika.career: New responsibilities or a leadership role could be placed in your capable hands. Stay focused on quality execution, as your efforts are under positive scrutiny.
Vrischika.finance: Career elevation brings prospects of enhanced financial stability and future increments. Make calculated, long-term decisions regarding major asset purchases.
Vrischika.relationships: Balancing rigorous work demands with domestic life requires conscious effort today. Reassure your loved ones of your dedication through small, affectionate gestures.
Vrischika.health: Maintain physical stamina by taking regular short breaks during demanding tasks. Simple joint rotations and posture awareness will alleviate physical fatigue.
Vrischika.remedy: Chant the Hanuman Chalisa and offer jaggery to birds or needy persons.

Dhanu.summary: Fortune smiles upon your path, awakening spiritual wisdom, optimism, and higher clarity.
Dhanu.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 9th house in Simha
Dhanu.general: A sense of purpose guides your endeavors, creating auspicious synchronicity in all matters. Engaging in spiritual pursuits or philosophical reading brings profound inner peace.
Dhanu.career: Mentors and advisors will provide priceless insights that propel your career forward. Academics, legal affairs, and publication ventures receive powerful favorable support.
Dhanu.finance: Luck supports your financial stability, making this a fine day for philanthropic giving. Sensible long-term investments will begin to show encouraging trends.
Dhanu.relationships: Meaningful conversations foster deep spiritual bonding with your life partner. Seeking counsel from elders or spiritual guides will resolve personal quandaries.
Dhanu.health: Vigor and mental peace remain robust, infusing optimism into your daily routine. A brisk walk outdoors in fresh air will enhance your vitality.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a chandan or turmeric tilak on your forehead and respect your mentors and teachers.

Makara.summary: Navigate the day with quiet patience and discretion, prioritizing safety and research.
Makara.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 8th house in Simha
Makara.general: Ashtama Chandra suggests maintaining a low profile and avoiding sudden drastic moves. Deep research, occult study, or auditing complex data will yield valuable revelations.
Makara.career: Stick to established routines and avoid getting embroiled in workplace arguments. Thoroughly verify every detail before signing critical documents or contracts.
Makara.finance: Exercise caution in joint financial accounts, inheritance, or tax-related matters. Avoid extending loans or making speculative commitments today.
Makara.relationships: Patience is your greatest ally in dealing with emotional turbulence or sensitive topics. Listening carefully to your partner's grievances will prevent misunderstandings.
Makara.health: Guard against anxiety and digestive sluggishness by having light, timely meals. Meditative practices will significantly steady your nervous system.
Makara.remedy: Chant the Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra 11 times and light a sesame oil lamp in the evening.

Kumbha.summary: Partnerships thrive through mutual respect, diplomacy, and shared aspirations.
Kumbha.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 7th house in Simha
Kumbha.general: Interpersonal dynamics take center stage, presenting chances to forge enduring alliances. Collaborative efforts proceed harmoniously when grounded in mutual understanding.
Kumbha.career: Client interactions, public relations, and joint ventures will see notable headway. Your diplomatic tact will effortlessly bridge divergent opinions in team meetings.
Kumbha.finance: Business collaborations and contractual deals show promising potential for growth. Ensure all contractual agreements have clear, mutually beneficial clauses.
Kumbha.relationships: Marital and romantic relations sparkle with affection, mutual respect, and joy. An evening spent sharing personal dreams will bring you and your partner closer.
Kumbha.health: Vitality is steady; balance your social energy with moments of physical relaxation. Keep your fluid intake high and practice gentle stretches.
Kumbha.remedy: Offer a mixture of water and black sesame seeds to the Peepal tree without touching it.

Meena.summary: Discipline and methodical effort lead to decisive victories over challenges and competitors.
Meena.moon_sign_position: Moon transits your 6th house in Simha
Meena.general: Your efficiency and problem-solving abilities shine as you systematically tackle obstacles. Focus on completing pending obligations with an organized and positive mindset.
Meena.career: You will outshine competitors and gain the upper hand in challenging work negotiations. Colleagues will appreciate your reliable support in resolving difficult tasks.
Meena.finance: Favorable indications for settling pending debts or obtaining advantageous credit terms. Sensible expense management allows you to keep finances well organized.
Meena.relationships: Offer practical assistance to your loved ones rather than just theoretical advice. Avoid over-analyzing relationships, letting natural affection flow easily.
Meena.health: Your immune system is resilient, but avoid irregular eating hours and overwork. Incorporate leafy greens and simple yoga postures into your routine.
Meena.remedy: Recite the Vishnu Sahasranama or chant 'Om Namo Narayanaya' 108 times.

tithi.name: Krishna Ekadashi
tithi.description: Rama Ekadashi; highly propitious for meditation, detoxifying the mind, and worship of Lord Vishnu.

Mesha.summary: Victorious strides over competition bring high productivity and inner relief.
Mesha.general: The sixth house transit fuels your resolve to clear pending hurdles effortlessly. Your analytical edge empowers you to convert difficulties into lasting triumphs.
Mesha.career: Colleagues and superiors will admire your practical problem-solving attitude. You will effectively resolve a lingering workplace dispute or project delay.
Mesha.finance: Financial prudence dominates today, making it ideal for clearing dues or settling debts. Guard against spontaneous retail splurges in the evening.
Mesha.relationships: Open and compassionate dialogue will resolve minor domestic misunderstandings. Keep ego aside when discussing family responsibilities.
Mesha.health: Vitality remains solid, though digestive sensitivity requires clean, light eating. Incorporate herbal teas into your routine.
Mesha.remedy: Chant the Vishnu Sahasranama or offer yellow flowers to Lord Vishnu.

Vrishabha.summary: Creative breakthroughs and intuitive intelligence illuminate your personal projects.
Vrishabha.general: Auspicious fifth house transit brings mental clarity, creative flair, and joyful interactions. You will feel inspired to develop innovative concepts that have long-term value.
Vrishabha.career: Your strategic planning and intellectual sharpness yield admiration from superiors. Academic pursuits and creative presentations flourish seamlessly.
Vrishabha.finance: Speculative ventures and calculated investments show promising prospects if analyzed thoroughly. Avoid emotionally driven expenditures.
Vrishabha.relationships: Warmth and romantic vibrancy elevate your bond with your partner. Joy through children or young family members brightens your spirit.
Vrishabha.health: Mental calm enhances your physical wellness. Dedicate time to pranayama or quiet contemplation in nature.
Vrishabha.remedy: Apply a chandan (sandalwood) tilak on your forehead before stepping out.

Mithuna.summary: Prioritize domestic harmony and emotional grounding to recharge your inner strength.
Mithuna.general: The Moon moving through your domestic sphere directs attention toward home and inner tranquility. Cultivate patient awareness to navigate minor emotional ebbs.
Mithuna.career: Focus on core responsibilities and complete documentation rather than starting new ventures. A supportive colleague helps simplify your professional tasks.
Mithuna.finance: Expenses related to domestic comfort, property, or family needs may arise. Stick to a structured budget to ensure monetary stability.
Mithuna.relationships: Maternal figures provide reassuring guidance and warmth today. Nurture peace within the household by listening more and advising less.
Mithuna.health: Watch out for mild chest congestion or lethargy caused by emotional fatigue. A brisk morning walk restores mental clarity.
Mithuna.remedy: Water a Tulsi plant and light an earthen ghee lamp near it at dusk.

Karka.summary: Courageous communication and purposeful short ventures open promising new avenues.
Karka.general: With Chandra in your third house, your confidence surges and initiatives gain vital momentum. Your proactive demeanor inspires peers and earns respect.
Karka.career: Networking, negotiations, and written communications bear fruitful outcomes. You will easily convince clients or team members of your vision.
Karka.finance: Modest gains through short-distance commerce or commission work are indicated. Prudent resource management safeguards your liquid savings.
Karka.relationships: Bonding with siblings or close neighbors brings cheer and constructive advice. Expressing your appreciation deepens ties with loved ones.
Karka.health: High energy levels allow you to conquer demanding schedules. Gentle shoulder and neck stretches will relieve any desk-bound tension.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk mixed with water to a Shiva Lingam in the morning.

Simha.summary: Eloquence and astute wealth management bring sweet rewards to your doorstep.
Simha.general: The second house lunar transit enhances your communicative magnetism and family harmony. Your refined speech creates goodwill and resolves past discords.
Simha.career: Financial discussions, wage negotiations, or corporate presentations yield favorable results. Your pragmatic inputs receive thoughtful validation from seniors.
Simha.finance: Savings get a positive boost, and previously stuck funds may materialize. Thoughtful budgeting ensures lasting economic security.
Simha.relationships: Family gatherings or heartfelt dinner conversations reinforce mutual trust. Your encouraging words uplift a younger relative's spirits.
Simha.health: Avoid excessively spicy or oily food to maintain throat and oral health. Stay well-hydrated throughout your active workday.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with a pinch of turmeric to the rising Sun while chanting Gayatri Mantra.

Kanya.summary: A wave of mental serenity and personal vitality allows you to lead with confidence.
Kanya.general: With the Moon gracing your Janma Rashi, intuition and intellect align seamlessly. Your organized approach ensures every endeavor you touch flows smoothly.
Kanya.career: You naturally attract leadership responsibilities and client trust today. Trust your instinctive analysis when handling complex data or deliverables.
Kanya.finance: Personal investments and financial reorganization look highly promising. Invest wisely in self-development tools or skill-building programs.
Kanya.relationships: Your calm aura fosters deep emotional comfort in personal relationships. Single natives may experience an intellectually captivating connection.
Kanya.health: Physical stamina and psychological poise remain at their peak. Channel excess vitality into structured yoga or meditation.
Kanya.remedy: Feed green grass or fresh spinach to a cow or chant 'Om Budhaya Namaha'.

Tula.summary: Graceful introspection and spiritual pause help dissolve lingering anxieties.
Tula.general: Chandra in your twelfth house calls for conscious rest, reflection, and mindful moderation. Steer clear of unverified gossip and retreat from chaotic environments.
Tula.career: Focus on research, back-end tasks, and solitary planning rather than aggressive expansion. Collaborations with distant or overseas partners show steady progress.
Tula.finance: Expenditures may increase on healthcare, charitable contributions, or travel. Exercise vigilance with online transactions and keep impulse buys in check.
Tula.relationships: Give partners adequate emotional space to prevent unintentional friction. Quiet empathy serves your bonds better than logical debates.
Tula.health: Prioritize quality sleep to counter mild restlessness or eye strain. Gentle meditation before bedtime will induce restorative rest.
Tula.remedy: Donate white grains or sesame seeds to the needy and practice silence for 20 minutes.

Vrischika.summary: Social alliances expand as long-cherished ambitions discover rewarding avenues.
Vrischika.general: The eleventh house transit generates gains, networking success, and celebratory moments. Your collaborative attitude draws influential mentors to your side.
Vrischika.career: Group projects thrive under your sharp guidance, achieving remarkable milestones. Professional aspirations align with favorable executive support.
Vrischika.finance: Monetary inflow improves through multiple channels or previous strategic investments. It is a rewarding day to plan your long-term retirement corpus.
Vrischika.relationships: Friendships bring joyous camaraderie and practical insights into personal matters. A social gathering will re-energize your emotional sphere.
Vrischika.health: Vitality is robust and enthusiasm high throughout the day. Maintain this momentum by engaging in light cardiovascular exercise.
Vrischika.remedy: Recite the Hanuman Chalisa and share roasted grams (chana) with others.

Dhanu.summary: Professional authority and public appreciation highlight an empowering Thursday.
Dhanu.general: Transiting your tenth house, the Moon illuminates your reputation, career drive, and executive skill. Your focused effort produces visible and praiseworthy results.
Dhanu.career: Your strategic vision earns applause from senior management and corporate partners. A high-impact assignment may be placed under your stewardship.
Dhanu.finance: Career gains translate into prospective long-term financial stability. Allocate surplus funds toward secure, value-appreciating assets.
Dhanu.relationships: Balancing professional commitments with family time will be essential. A brief, reassuring call to your spouse or parents keeps affection intact.
Dhanu.health: Energy levels remain steady, though back or knee fatigue may surface if overworked. Ensure ergonomic seating during prolonged work hours.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply saffron (kesar) tilak on your navel and forehead to enhance Jupiter's blessings.

Makara.summary: Fortuitous winds guide your intellectual pursuits and expand your philosophical horizons.
Makara.general: The ninth house transit activates the bhagya sthana, elevating your moral clarity, luck, and wisdom. Long-distance plans or scholarly endeavors receive cosmic backing.
Makara.career: Mentors and industry veterans offer transformative counsel that refines your career path. Legal matters or institutional approvals lean favorably in your direction.
Makara.finance: Financial fortune flourishes through principled dealings and ethical investments. Consider setting aside an amount for philanthropic giving.
Makara.relationships: Conversations around philosophy, culture, and ethics bridge gaps with loved ones. Respecting elders' traditions fosters enduring domestic warmth.
Makara.health: A sense of inner peace keeps physical ailments at bay. Deep diaphragmatic breathing will further invigorate your nervous system.
Makara.remedy: Light a mustard oil lamp under a Peepal tree and bow with reverence.

Kumbha.summary: Deep analytical focus unlocks hidden solutions; navigate transitions with patience.
Kumbha.general: The eighth house transit urges discretion, research, and emotional fortitude. Avoid rash confrontations and utilize this day for deep problem resolution.
Kumbha.career: Uncover hidden details in auditing, data analysis, or confidential work. Postpone signing critical long-term contracts until tomorrow morning.
Kumbha.finance: Refrain from joint financial speculations or lending money to acquaintances. Review insurance policies and ensure tax documentation is up to date.
Kumbha.relationships: Honesty combined with softness prevents unnecessary interpersonal insecurities. Give your partner room to express their unspoken worries.
Kumbha.health: Practice mindfulness to ease nervous stress and joint stiffness. Staying hydrated and getting adequate rest will maintain equilibrium.
Kumbha.remedy: Chant the Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra 11 times for protection and mental clarity.

Meena.summary: Harmonious partnerships and diplomatic finesse bring mutual prosperity and joy.
Meena.general: The Moon directly aspects your sign from the seventh house, enhancing social grace and interpersonal bonding. Collaborative ventures yield fruitful outcomes.
Meena.career: Client relations and negotiations proceed with remarkable warmth and mutual benefit. Your ability to bridge divergent views makes you indispensable in meetings.
Meena.finance: Financial gains via partnerships, contracts, or spouse's support are favorably indicated. Mutual investments made today hold strong growth potential.
Meena.relationships: Romantic connection deepens through shared laughter and mutual respect. Single Meena natives might encounter an endearing prospective match.
Meena.health: Physical balance and emotional vitality are pleasantly aligned. Maintain this glow by enjoying fresh seasonal fruits and pure water.
Meena.remedy: Offer yellow sweets (laddus) or yellow grams (chana dal) at a temple.
